schema.aggregation: pair return = mean(A, B) per policy(A/B 不拆散)
schema.difficulty: difficulty_pair[p] = reference_pair[p] - always_flat_pair[p](唯一难度口径)
schema.margin: margin[p,b] = reference_pair[p] - baseline_b_pair[p](逐固定基线;禁止 episode 级 max)
schema.gap: adjacent rung gap = mean_hi - mean_lo;SE_gap = sqrt(SE_hi^2 + SE_lo^2)(独立 corpus 样本)
